This is your final 4-week run-in: Weeks 1-2 are late-camp maintenance, Week 3 tapers, and Week 4 is fight week. The gym work is minimum-effective-dose only to keep strength and sharpness without stealing from MMA or the cut. Hard sparring should already be tapering down: about 2 hard contacts in Week 1, 1 early hard contact in Week 3, and none in fight week; the last truly hard contact should be early in Week 3.

Week 2 only nudges the Tuesday Pull-up load if Week 1 stays crisp; otherwise repeat Week 1 exactly. Week 3 drops sets across the board while keeping fast reps and full rest. Week 4 keeps the usual Tue/Fri slots, with the notes marked Day -6 and Day -3 so both sessions stay brief primer touches.

Keep the right knee at or below your normal 3/10 response. If Reverse Lunge or Barbell Hip Thrust pushes pain or next-day stiffness above baseline, shorten range or stop one set early; if Friday knee feels off, replace Reverse Lunge with 2 more fast Prowler Push runs. Do not bring heavy Back Squat back in during this block. Weight-cut details are medical and outside this plan.

CAMP SCHEDULE
Sport sessions are load. The gym is built around them, and the contact comes down as the fight approaches.

 Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun hard contact
W1 MMA hard MMA moderate + gym MMA hard MMA moderate MMA technical + gym MMA moderate MMA light 2 of 3
W2 MMA hard MMA moderate + gym MMA hard MMA moderate MMA technical + gym MMA moderate MMA light 2 of 3
W3 MMA hard MMA moderate + gym MMA technical MMA moderate MMA technical + gym MMA moderate MMA light 1 of 3
W4 MMA technical MMA moderate + gym MMA technical MMA moderate MMA technical + gym MMA moderate MMA light 0 of 3

Hard contact falls 2 to 0 across the block. The last hard session sits far enough from Day 0 that soreness, cognitive fatigue and sleep disruption have resolved.

START_WEEK1_TSV
Day	Exercise	Weight	Sets	Reps	Rest	Target RPE	Notes	Results
Tue	[WARMUP] Band Pull-Apart Warm-up	Bodyweight	1	15	30 sec	3	Then 2-3 quick ramp sets for Pull-up and Barbell Hip Thrust.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Tue	[WARMUP] Bodyweight Squat	Bodyweight	1	8	30 sec	3	Easy range only; use this as a knee check, not fatigue.	
Tue	Trap Bar Jump	Light, speed-first load	3	3	2 min	7	Light and fast: this is a speed exposure, not a lift. Land softly, reset every rep, and keep the load low enough that the bar moves quickly. Session trimmed for camp: what remains is here because it keeps strength, speed or tissue readiness, not because it is easy.	
Tue	Pull-up	RPE-selected load	2	2	150 sec	7	Crisp doubles only; stop after 1 set if RPE goes above 7.5, elbow or shoulder irritation appears, or rep speed slows.	
Tue	Barbell Hip Thrust	RPE-selected load	2	3	150 sec	7	Fast lockout intent; stop after 1 set if knee or back symptoms rise or speed drops.	
Tue	Dumbbell Bench Press	RPE-selected load	2	4	90 sec	7	Leave about 3 reps in reserve; keep shoulders fresh, no grinders.	
Tue	Side Plank	Bodyweight	2	25 sec/side	30 sec	6	Trunk stiffness for grappling; if time gets tight keep 2 set per side.	
Fri	[WARMUP] Band Pull-Apart Warm-up	Bodyweight	1	15	30 sec	3	Then 1-2 easy ramp sets for Reverse Lunge and Seated Cable Row.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Fri	[WARMUP] Bodyweight Squat	Bodyweight	1	8	30 sec	3	Easy range only; skip any depth that irritates the knee.	
Fri	Push-up	Bodyweight	2	3	60 sec	5	Explosive reps for sharpness; stop if speed fades.	
Fri	Reverse Lunge	RPE-selected load	2	4/side	90 sec	6.5	Comfortable knee-dominant maintenance; keep torso tall and do not grind.	
Fri	Seated Cable Row	RPE-selected load	2	5	75 sec	7	Crisp horizontal pulling; leave about 3 reps in reserve.	
Fri	Neck Isometric	Bodyweight	2	15 sec/direction	30 sec	6	Low-cost neck capacity; first item to remove if MMA runs long or fatigue is high.	
Fri	Prowler Push	RPE-selected load	4	15 m	60 sec	N/A	Low-cost Friday session; fast short drives only, full reset, stop before leg burn or speed loss.	
END_WEEK1_TSV

TAPER AUDIT
Event: combat, priority A, about 3.9 weeks out.
This block runs into the event: the final week is competition week.
Sport sessions counted as load: 7 per week.

    phase             sets  exercises  competition lift  power sets  peak RPE  peak % max
W1  late camp         23    10         -                 3           7         -
W2  late camp         23    10         -                 3           7.5       -
W3  taper             16    7          -                 9           7         -
W4  competition week  11    5          -                 6           7         -

Across the block: volume -12 sets, exercises -5, competition-lift share unchanged, peak effort unchanged, accessory volume -8 sets.
